table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	St.Icode,
	AliasName= i.customicode,
	Item = i.name, 
	openqty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='OP' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	openvalue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='OP' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	PurQty 	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	PurValue  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PV' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	PRetQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PR' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	PRetValue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PR' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	SaleQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	SaleValue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	SRetQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	SRetValue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	IssueQty  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='IV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	IssueValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='IV' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	DueSatisfyQty  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='DS' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	DueSatisfyValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='DS' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	ReceiptQty=SUM(CASE WHEN type='RV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	ReceiptValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='RV' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	AdjQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='AI' THEN qty 
								WHEN type='AD' THEN -qty 
								ELSE 0 END),
	AdjValue  =SUM(CASE  WHEN type='AI' THEN value 
								WHEN type='AD' THEN -value  
								ELSE 0 END),
	TransferINQty  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='TI' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	TransferINValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='TI' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	TransferOutQty  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='TO' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	TransferOutValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='TO' THEN value ELSE 0 END)
FROM
	(SELECT type='OP', icode, qty = sum(qty), value=0
	FROM	(select	pd.icode, qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
			when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
			else looseqty + bonusqty end, 0))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
			pd.Gcode IN (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
	      pl.postdate < CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	pd.icode, qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
			pd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
	      pl.date < CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
			sd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
	      sl.date < CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND sd.Due IS NULL
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
			sd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
	      sl.postdate < CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = -sum(sd.qty)
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
			sd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
	      sl.date < CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = sum(sd.qty)
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
			sd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
	      sl.postdate < CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
			sd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
	      sl.posteddate < CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty = -sum(sd.looseqty)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
			sd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
	      sl.date < CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode, qty = -sum(sd.qty)
	FROM THeader sl, TDetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Transcode = sd.Transcode and 
		sl.SGcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
		sl.postdate < CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.qty)
	FROM THeader sl, TDetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Transcode = sd.Transcode and 
		sl.DGcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
		sl.postdate < CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	d.icode, 	qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty)
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d
	WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
		d.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
		h.duesatisfydate < CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By d.icode) A
	GROUP BY icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PV',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(case pl.purcatcode when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
				when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
				else (looseqty + bonusqty) end),
		value = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty)
			when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty)
			else looseqty + bonusqty 
			end, 0) * pd.purprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
		pd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
		pl.postdate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PR',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits),
		value = sum((pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits) *
			pd.prprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
			pd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
	      pl.date >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
			sd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
	      sl.date >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SR',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
		sd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
		sl.postdate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='IV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
		sd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
		sl.date >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='DS',
		d.icode,
		qty = sum(d.duesatisfyqty),
		value = sum(d.duesatisfyqty * (d.packsaleprice / case d.packunits when 0 then 1 else d.packunits end))
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d
	WHERE h.duesatisfycode = d.duesatisfycode AND
		d.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
		h.duesatisfydate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) 
	Group By d.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='RV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
		sd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
		sl.postdate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) 
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AI',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
		sd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
		sl.posteddate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AD',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
		sd.Gcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
		sl.date >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='TO',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * (sd.saleprice / CASE sd.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE sd.packunits END))
	FROM THeader sl, TDetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Transcode = sd.Transcode and 
		sl.SGcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
		sl.postdate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='TI',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * (sd.saleprice / CASE sd.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE sd.packunits END))
	FROM THeader sl, TDetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Transcode = sd.Transcode and 
		sl.DGcode = (SELECT AG.GCode FROM AccountGodown AG WHERE AG.AccCode = :ai_custcode) AND
		sl.postdate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT type='OP', icode, qty = 0, value=0 FROM ITEM) St, 
	Item i
WHERE st.icode = i.icode AND i.iccode = 1
GROUP BY St.icode, i.name, i.customicode, i.saleprice, i.packunits
ORDER BY i.name

objects.name: compute_48
objects.expression: sum(openqty + purqty - pretqty - saleqty + sretqty - duesatisfyqty - issueqty + receiptqty + adjqty + transferinqty -  transferoutqty for all)

objects.name: closingstockqty
objects.expression: openqty + purqty - pretqty - saleqty + sretqty - duesatisfyqty - issueqty + receiptqty + adjqty + transferinqty -  transferoutqty
